createOrReplace.title: Entry Requirements - NYU Abu Dhabi
createOrReplace.excerpt: NYU Abu Dhabi considers each applicant through a comprehensive review process, taking into account their academic preparation, achievements, and experiences ... Applicants should demonstrate strong academic preparation for university-level study. Many NYU Abu Dhabi degree pathways require rigorous quantitative coursework ... Building a strong foundation in calculus in high school ensures you can transition smoothly. NYU will remain test-optional through the 2027–2028 application cycle ... Results from standardized testing exams are an important criteria for evaluating our global pool of applicants. Applicants whose first language is not English are generally required to submit results from a proficiency exam taken within the last two years.

createOrReplace.title: Cost of Attendance | NYU Bulletins
createOrReplace.excerpt: NYU Abu Dhabi Estimated Cost of Attendance 2026-2027 (U.S. dollars, two semesters): Tuition $68,576; Student Health Insurance $2,308; Books and Supplies $1,730; Food $5,800; Housing $6,000; Estimated Total Direct Costs $84,414; Estimated Transportation $3,550; Estimated Personal Expenses $2,364; Estimated Total Indirect Costs $5,914; Total Cost of Attendance (estimated) $90,328.
